metadata.title: Earth Hologenome Initiative (EHI) Data Release 2: sequence files of metagenome assembled genomes (MAGs)
metadata.description:
A four-part tarball containing the FASTA files of the 11,538 metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs) published in the 2nd Data Release of the Earth Hologenome Initiative.

Reconstruct and decompress the archive with:
cat ehi_data_release_2_mags.tar.gz.part-* > ehi_data_release_2_mags.tar.gz
tar -xvzf ehi_data_release_2_mags.tar.gz
